title: Gideon and the Veil
author: G. M. Pemberton
blurb: Marguerite Ashgrove, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
